title: I'm creating characters for a new horror game
author: Over_Video775
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/o86k8dv1na3h1.gif

I started using artificial intelligence to have it generate models and animations on its own. A couple of characters are already done. What do you think? Is it very obvious?

replies.author: Over_Video775
replies.body: Thank you. The game will be in the same style as Dishonored.

replies.author: atlasfrompaladins
replies.body: Cool, that was badass game. Keep us posted on anything new you got cooking up man.

replies.author: Over_Video775
replies.body: I'll be right back. The main thing is to get lots of likes and comments so people can at least hear about the game. You can even give me a hard time—I actually like that)

comments.author: EnumeratedArray
comments.body: Looks pretty good! What have you used to generate the models?

replies.author: Over_Video775
replies.body: It's really simple; it only takes a couple of minutes. First, use AI to generate the character's concept art. Then, use AI to create the model—Hunyang works well for this. Next, use Substance Painter, 3DCoat, ZBrush, 3ds Max, and Mixamo, and then import it into Unity 3D. A little bit of everything
